## Definition of Done (see /docs/DOD.md)

- [ ] Unit test covers the behaviour (design-pattern classes tested)
- [ ] `npm run verify` is green (format, lint, typecheck, coverage)
- [ ] No import reaches into another slice's internals
- [ ] Docs/README updated if the slice's public surface changed
- [ ] Web changes follow /docs/UI.md: components from `@/ui`, colour from the
      theme, no inline styles, no new UI dependency
